170.csv::77.source_text:
フッフッフ、まぁ聞きたまえ！
俺は祭りってものが大好きなのだ
先日も、ある村で伝統的な祭りに参加したんだが
これがまた面白い祭りでね
170.csv::77.translated_text: Heh heh heh! Well then, hearken! I do love festivals, 'tis true. Just the other day, at some village, I joined a traditional festival, but this was yet another amusing one, 'tis.
170.csv::77.speaker: Angelo
